title: Actual finite coefficient routes and their derived restriction mate
statement: For supplied UniformizerSquareData q [def-diagonal-uniformizer-root-frame], let C be the derived internal Z_l-module category on W=diagonalSurface Y. Define TC as cyclic derived scalar extension followed by the supplied cyclic finite realization; define TA as successive integral and uniformizer derived scalar extensions followed by the supplied A-realization. restriction is the actual ordinary restriction along cartierResidueAlgebra. cyclicSource and quotientSource are the composites of the supplied supported endpoints with exact single comparisons and ordinary source comparisons. cyclicTarget and quotientTarget are the composites of the supplied degree-two line endpoints with exact shift/single comparisons and ordinary line comparisons. cyclicRight and quotientRight compose the inverse finite equivalences with the actual internal scalar restriction functors. inverseUnderlying is the underlying/counit comparison of the inverse finite realization. RestrictionNormalized(s) requires the ordinary right-functor isomorphism s to have exactly the underlying identity transported through these isomorphisms. comparison(s):TC -> TA followed by derived restriction is constructed as the mate of derived s under the composite actual scalar and realization adjunctions. It uses no existence theorem. SourceEquation(s) is its comparison equation at the supported constant object; TargetEquation(s) is its equation at the shifted integral-line object. The domain and codomain of the supplied initial arrow retain the exact endpoint types; its value does not enter either proposition, and neither imposes a class equation.
